messages.血鬼の味方と組んで戦場の出血ダメージを「血餐」に貯め、それを消耗して得た硬血15: Fight alongside Bloodfiends to accumulate Bleed damage dealt on the field as Bloodfeast. Spend it to gain at least 15 Hardblood and enhance S3 into Ascendant Sancho Hardblood Arts - La Sangre, then strike enemies with high Bleed for heavy damage.
messages.血餐と硬血: この人格がいると、全キャラクターが受けた出血ダメージだけ血餐が増え: **Bloodfeast and Hardblood**: While this Identity is present, Bloodfeast increases by the Bleed damage taken by all characters, shared by everyone, up to 999. Her un-enhanced S1–S3 spend up to 50 Bloodfeast on use, and her un-enhanced Defense skill does so at Combat Start, to gain Hardblood; enhanced skills do not spend Bloodfeast. S1 Enough is Enough gives 1 Hardblood per 5 Bloodfeast, and the others give 1 per 10. **If she cannot spend Bloodfeast, she gains Bleed herself.**
messages.「サンチョ流硬血奥義-ラ・サングレ」: ターン開始時に硬血15以上なら、最も左の: **Ascendant Sancho Hardblood Arts - La Sangre**: If she has at least 15 Hardblood at Turn Start, her leftmost S3 is enhanced into this skill. All 4 Coins are Unbreakable. +1 Coin Power if/for every 5 Bleed when the target has at least 10, up to 2. It also gains +5% damage per Bleed on the target, up to 50%, and +20% per 100 Bloodfeast Consumed (shared), up to 100%. After the attack, it spends 10 per 10 Hardblood. If the target dies, Bloodfeast increases by 50/100 and half of the Hardblood spent is returned, once per turn.
messages.S3で敵を倒して補給: 強化前のS3「貫かせていただきましょう」も、対象が死亡す: **Resupply by defeating enemies with S3**: When the target of her un-enhanced S3 I Shall Impale dies, Bloodfeast increases by 30/60 and she gains 10 Hardblood, once per turn.
messages.血鬼の味方で硬血が貯まる: 常時発動パッシブ「亜流サンチョ硬血式」により、自分以: **Bloodfiend allies build Hardblood**: Through the passive Variant Sancho Hardblood Arts, which is always active, she gains 2 Hardblood each time an ally other than herself takes Bleed damage or spends Bloodfeast, 3 times per turn. While Gregor's The Priest of La Manchaland, Outis's The Barber of La Manchaland, or Rodion's The Princess of La Manchaland is participating or has died, her S1, S2, or Defense skill respectively is also enhanced at 15 or more Hardblood.
messages.吸血: 各スキルは的中時、与ダメージ量の一部だけ体力を回復する(S1・S2は30: **Lifesteal**: Each skill heals HP on hit equal to part of the damage dealt (S1 and S2: 30%, up to 10; S3: 50%, up to 10; La Sangre: 50%, up to 20).
messages.出血を付ける味方、特にラ・マンチャランドの血鬼と組んで血餐を貯める。S1で効率よ: Pair her with allies who inflict Bleed, especially the Bloodfiends of La Manchaland, to build Bloodfeast. Use S1 to efficiently build Hardblood to 15. Fire La Sangre at enemies with at least 10 Bleed to trigger as many damage bonuses as possible. It spends a lot of Hardblood, so aim to defeat enemies and recover Bloodfeast and Hardblood. If Bloodfeast is 0 early on, she gains Bleed herself, so watch the remaining amount. Hardblood also raises Offense and Defense Levels and Speed based on its amount, but this cannot be confirmed from the Identity data.
